summary: Systematically optimized learning rates for embedding layers. Found that combining EMBEDDING_LR=0.8 with UNEMBEDDING_LR=0.02 achieves 0.995414 val_bpb, beating baseline (0.997333) by ~0.19%. Discovered that UNEMBEDDING_LR boost is more valuable than EMBEDDING_LR boost alone. Tested 6 variations including warmdown ratio, weight decay, MATRIX_LR, and FINAL_LR_FRAC adjustments; none improved on the optimal combination. EMBEDDING_LR values beyond 0.8 (tested 0.9, 1.0) degrade performance.
